findings.evidence: `Boundary.lean:150,204,333,393` define the bundled maps and call the sphere maps restrictions; `Automorphism/Basic.lean:41,47,53` provides the existing standard open-disc equivalence and coercion API, while `rg` finds no compatibility declaration in `Boundary.lean`.
findings.fix: Add simp lemmas expressing the commuting inclusions for both Möbius and standard families, from the open disc into the closed ball and from the sphere into the closed ball.
findings.issue: The four bundled homeomorphisms are described as extensions/restrictions, but no compatibility lemma connects the closed-ball maps to `unitDiscMoebiusEquiv`/`unitDiscStandardAutomorphismEquiv`, or the sphere maps to their closed-ball counterparts.

summary: The homeomorphisms have scalar coercion formulas, but the API never states that they extend the existing open-disc automorphisms or that the sphere versions are restrictions of the closed-ball versions.
